We introduce a novel QA task, FinCode, built from professional exams. We also create two code-generation tasks CodeTAT-QA and CodeFinQA by reformulating the existing financial QA datasets TAT-QA  and FinQA .
outputs: Generated Python code that is executed to produce a numeric answer.
